epics.title: Real AI Demand Forecasting
epics.summary: Replace the mocked `_ask_ai` with a real LLM call plus a statistical baseline, store forecast history and measure accuracy.
epics.overview: `action_generate_ai_insights` builds a prompt but ignores the response: `predicted_demand` is hard-coded as `avg_daily * 7 * 1.2` and `_ask_ai` returns a fixed string. Restock decisions in `action_check_and_restock` depend on these numbers, so the 'AI' part of the module is not real yet.

features.title: Connect a real LLM in `_ask_ai` with settings
features.summary: Call the Claude API (or another provider) from `_ask_ai`, configured from Settings, with timeout and safe fallback.
scope: `res.config.settings` fields: provider, API key (stored in `ir.config_parameter`), model, enable flag
HTTP call with timeout and retry; no key → fallback to baseline (E1.2)
Log each call (product, tokens, latency) without the API key
ac: With a valid key, insights come from the API response
With no key or a timeout, the cron still finishes using the baseline
API key never appears in logs or chatter
clarity: Which provider and model? (suggest Claude Haiku for bulk runs, cost per product)

features.title: Structured JSON response parsing
features.summary: Ask the model for JSON (`prediction`, `risk`, `insight`) and validate it before writing fields.
scope: Validate types and ranges (prediction >= 0, risk in low/medium/high)
Invalid response → baseline values + warning log
ac: `predicted_demand`, `risk_level`, `ai_insight` come from the parsed response
Malformed JSON does not raise in the cron
Unit tests cover valid, malformed and out-of-range responses

features.title: Statistical baseline forecast
features.summary: Compute a weighted moving average with day-of-week seasonality as the baseline and the fallback when AI is off.
ac: Baseline is deterministic and covered by tests with fixed sales data
AI prompt includes the baseline so the model adjusts it rather than guessing

features.title: Forecast history and accuracy (MAPE)
features.summary: Store each forecast in a history model and compare it with actual sales to show accuracy per product.
scope: `smart.inventory.forecast` model: product, date, horizon, predicted, actual, source (ai/baseline)
Daily cron fills `actual` when the horizon has passed
MAPE per product on product form and dashboard
ac: A forecast record is written on every insight run
MAPE matches a hand calculation in tests
Access rights added in `security/ir.model.access.csv`

features.title: Batch AI runs and cost control
features.summary: Run AI only for products that changed, in batches, with a daily call budget.
scope: Skip products with no sales and no stock change since `last_ai_update`
Batch size and daily max calls in settings
Commit per batch so a failure does not roll back the whole cron
ac: Cron on 1,000 products makes at most the configured number of calls
Partial failure keeps already-updated products

epics.title: Smart Replenishment Engine
epics.summary: Turn auto-restock into proper replenishment: reorder point and safety stock, better vendor choice, one PO per vendor and an approval step.
epics.overview: Today restock uses a fixed `low_stock_threshold` and `restock_quantity`, picks the first vendor, ignores lead time and creates one PO per product. `sale_order._check_low_stock_and_create_po` and `product.action_check_and_restock` use different rules and origins, so duplicates are possible.

features.title: Reorder point and safety stock from lead time
features.summary: Compute reorder point = demand during lead time + safety stock, using the vendor lead time and demand variability.
scope: Safety stock = z x sigma(daily demand) x sqrt(lead time), service level in settings
Option to keep the manual threshold per product
ac: Reorder point shown on product form
Restock triggers when forecast stock < reorder point
Tests with known demand and lead time

features.title: Order quantity with MOQ and pack size
features.summary: Order enough to reach target cover days, rounded up to vendor minimum quantity and pack size.
ac: PO quantity is >= MOQ and a multiple of pack size
No PO when on-order quantity already covers demand

features.title: Vendor selection by price and lead time
features.summary: Choose the vendor from supplier info by valid date, price and lead time instead of `seller_ids[0]`.
scope: Use Odoo `_select_seller` with quantity and date
Preferred vendor still wins when set
ac: Cheapest valid vendor is chosen in tests
Expired supplier lines are ignored

features.title: Consolidate auto-POs per vendor
features.summary: Add lines to an existing draft auto-PO for the same vendor instead of creating one PO per product, and use one shared code path for cron and sale-triggered restock.
scope: One `_smart_restock(products)` used by cron, sale confirm and the dashboard button
Single origin tag, merge into draft PO of same vendor
Count quantity already on draft/confirmed POs
ac: Cron run for 10 low products of 2 vendors creates 2 POs
Running twice does not duplicate lines
`sale_order.py` no longer has its own PO logic

features.title: Approval before sending auto-RFQs
features.summary: Auto-POs above an amount need a manager's approval; approvers get an activity and can approve from the dashboard.
ac: PO over threshold cannot be confirmed by a normal user
Approver sees pending list on the dashboard

features.title: Sync with Odoo reordering rules
features.summary: Optionally write the computed min/max into `stock.warehouse.orderpoint` so standard Odoo replenishment can be used instead of custom POs.
scope: Mode setting: custom POs or orderpoints
Update min/max on each insight run
ac: In orderpoint mode no custom POs are created
Orderpoint min equals the computed reorder point

epics.title: Multi-Warehouse and Stock Health
epics.summary: Per-warehouse forecasting, transfer suggestions before buying, expiry alerts, ABC/XYZ classes and dead-stock detection.
epics.overview: All logic uses company-wide `qty_available`. Companies with several warehouses get one forecast and may buy stock that another warehouse has in excess. There is no view of slow or expiring stock.

features.title: Per-warehouse thresholds and forecast
features.summary: Store forecast and reorder point per product and warehouse, using `with_context(warehouse_id=...)` quantities.
scope: PO picking type set to the warehouse that needs stock
ac: Two warehouses get separate forecasts
PO is delivered to the right warehouse

features.title: Inter-warehouse transfer suggestion
features.summary: Before buying, suggest an internal transfer when another warehouse has stock above its own cover.
scope: Excess = on hand - reorder point - safety stock
Suggestion list with one-click transfer creation
ac: No PO is proposed when a transfer can cover the shortage
Created transfer has correct source and destination

features.title: Lot expiry alerts
features.summary: Warn about lots near expiry and exclude expired stock from available quantity in forecasts.
ac: Expired lots are not counted as available for restock decisions
Alert lists lots within the window
clarity: Make `product_expiry` a hard dependency or a bridge module?

features.title: ABC/XYZ classification
features.summary: Classify products by sales value (ABC) and demand variability (XYZ) and use the class to set service levels.
scope: Class on product, filter and group-by
ac: Class boundaries 80/15/5 by value by default
Changing class updates safety stock

features.title: Dead and slow-moving stock report
features.summary: List products with stock but no sales in N days, with value tied up, and stop auto-restock for them.
scope: Auto-restock is skipped for dead stock
ac: Report matches products with no confirmed sale in the window
Dead products get no auto-PO

epics.title: Dashboard, Alerts and Reports
epics.summary: Make the OWL dashboard a decision screen: KPIs, forecast charts, filters, alerts and exports.
epics.overview: The dashboard (`static/src/js/dashboard.js`) shows shortage lists, activity and pending PO count. It has no stock value, turnover or trend charts, no filters, and users only learn about risks by opening it.

features.title: Inventory KPI tiles
features.summary: Add stock value, inventory turnover, days of cover, fill rate and stockout count tiles, computed server-side.
ac: Each KPI matches a reference calculation in tests
Dashboard loads with one RPC for KPIs

features.title: Demand vs forecast chart
features.summary: Per-product chart of actual sales, forecast and stock level over time, using E1.4 history.
scope: Open from product row or product form
ac: Chart shows the last 90 days and the next horizon
Works in light and dark theme

features.title: Dashboard filters
features.summary: Filter dashboard by product category, warehouse, vendor and risk level.
scope: Filter bar state kept in URL/session
ac: Selecting a category updates every card
Filters persist on reload

features.title: Daily risk digest alerts
features.summary: Send a daily email / Discuss message with high-risk products and pending auto-POs to subscribed users.
ac: Digest lists exactly the high-risk products
No email on days with no risks

features.title: Export reports (XLSX / PDF)
features.summary: Export the shortage list, forecast and dead-stock reports to XLSX and PDF.
ac: Export totals equal on-screen totals

epics.title: Configurable Sales Flow, Security and Quality
epics.summary: Make the hard-coded sale automation configurable, fix Odoo 19 compatibility, add access groups, tests and CI.
epics.overview: `sale_order.action_confirm` always blocks out-of-stock sales, auto-invoices and auto-validates delivery, and `write()` repeats this on every `state='sale'` write. Product type checks use `type == 'product'` / `detailed_type`, which no longer exist in Odoo 19 (storable is `is_storable`). Only one test file exists and there is no CI.

features.title: Fix Odoo 19 storable-product checks
features.summary: `_validate_stock_availability` uses `type == 'product'` and `_check_low_stock_and_create_po` uses `detailed_type`; in Odoo 19 the stock check never runs and `detailed_type` may raise AttributeError.
scope: Regression test confirming a sale with a storable product
ac: Out-of-stock storable product blocks confirmation
Low-stock PO logic runs without AttributeError
Test added

features.title: Settings toggles for sale automation
features.summary: Settings to turn on/off: block out-of-stock sales, auto-invoice, auto-deliver; allow partial delivery with backorder.
scope: Remove duplicate automation from `write()` (keep it in `action_confirm`)
Backorder option when blocking is off
ac: Each toggle off restores standard Odoo behaviour
Confirming an order runs automation once, not twice

features.title: Security groups and record rules
features.summary: Add 'Smart Inventory User' and 'Manager' groups; only managers change thresholds, run manual restock and see AI settings.
ac: A user without the manager group cannot trigger restock
Tests check access errors

features.title: Test suite for restock and AI flows
features.summary: Add tests for restock decisions, PO consolidation, AI fallback and sale automation.
scope: Fixtures for products, vendors, sales history
ac: `--test-enable` passes on a fresh DB
Coverage of `models/` above 70%

features.title: GitHub Actions CI
features.summary: CI that installs the module on Odoo 19 + PostgreSQL and runs tests and a Python linter on each PR.
ac: PR shows passing CI
Failing test blocks merge
